query_rule: Agent <char>.<T> = public (learned_at <= T) + char.<char> where learned_at <= T (knowledge) or said_at <= T (claims: a character remembers everything it said up to T). Never query truth for agents.

factblocks.text: Minjae wore a gray hoodie every day.
Only Jisoo, Dohyun and Minjae hold the deploy-bot key.
The shared server-room admin card is kept in Minjae's desk drawer. Only Minjae has the drawer key.
Jisoo and Dohyun, friends from a university startup club, co-founded Moonlight Labs.
Minjae, Jisoo's university classmate, joined as the first engineer.
Moonlight moved into the Pangyo building where Mr. Kim worked as a guard.
At move-in, a developer in a gray hoodie signed out the shared server-room admin card.

Minjae built deploy-bot, the shared deploy account.
Moonlight raised its seed round.

Hana joined Moonlight as a design intern.

Minjae promised to get Hana an internship interview at Nova AI.
